== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[A Cunning Warrior (Errata)]]: the region (652, 948, 700, 988) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[A Cunning Warrior (Errata)]] (PC-E1): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/f004c6a7a6acb216e5ea1ff795bb023c921c0a84/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/acunningwarrior.gif Holotable commit f004c6a] (2025-02-02). The matching before crop is [[:File:V24-L-acunningwarrior-2025-02-02-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[A Cunning Warrior]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/acunningwarrior.gif commit efc26cd]) and [[A Cunning Warrior (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/f004c6a7a6acb216e5ea1ff795bb023c921c0a84/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/acunningwarrior.gif commit f004c6a]).
